clauses: This distinguished individual was a prominent mathematician, university teacher, and politician.
Throughout their career, they held influential academic roles, serving as both a rector and a chairperson.

In addition to their contributions to mathematics, they were appointed as a senator of the Kingdom of Italy and received prestigious honors, including being made a grand officer of the Order of the Crown of Italy and receiving the Order of Saints Maurice and Lazarus.
However, despite their involvement in national politics, they never served as a member of the Chamber of Deputies of the Kingdom of Italy.
